name: uMobix
title: umobix.com
shortDescription: uMobix is a comprehensive mobile monitoring solution designed for modern parents who want to ensure their children's safety in the digital world. It allows parents to track over 40 apps, view call logs, read messages, and monitor social media interactions. Parents can also control device access, ensuring children are not exposed to harmful content. An example use case is a parent monitoring their child's interactions on social media to prevent cyberbullying.
